The 400 g non-euqiatomic TiZrVNbAl MCIA ingot was prepared by vacuum levitation melting Ti, Zr, V, Nb, Al metals with high purity (>99.9 wt%) in a water-cooled copper crucible with a dimension of Φ 60 mm × 60 mm under argon atmosphere, and the ingots were remelted at least three times to obtain homogenous ingots.
The as-cast ingots were solution treated at 1000 °C for 1 h followed by water quenching (named as 1000T) to obtain single phase structure with homogeneous element distribution
aged at 800 °C, 780 °C, and 760 °C for 8 h followed by water quenching to obtain O-phase precipitates with different contents (named as 800A, 780A, and 760A respectively)
